title: Remove Must Perform Operation Comments
description: Remove all comments with the scheme: "* MUST perform the * operation" from the codebase. These are documentation comments that follow a specific pattern and need to be cleaned up from all source files.
summary: Successfully removed all comments with the pattern "* MUST perform the * operation" from the codebase. The cleanup covered Go (.go), Rust (.rs), TypeScript (.ts), and Python (.py) files across the entire compose repository. A total of 9 source files were modified, removing over 1500 redundant documentation comments.
